reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Establishment of Division of Weights and Measures and director
headings.reviewNote: Regarding creation of division within department of agriculture and appointment of director and personnel.

headings.title: Funding of compensation and division operating expenses
headings.reviewNote: Directing payment of division personnel compensation, supplies, and expenses from general assembly appropriations.

headings.title: Powers and duties of division on behalf of citizens
headings.reviewNote: Detailing division responsibilities for device accuracy, deception prevention, calibration, uniformity, and rulemaking.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1983–2002 history note; confirmed Division of Weights and Measures creation, general assembly appropriation funding, and five citizen-protection functions.

headings.title: Required methods of sale for liquid and nonliquid commodities
headings.reviewNote: Mandates sale of liquid commodities by liquid measure or weight and nonliquid commodities by weight, measure, or count, subject to director or trade-custom exceptions.

headings.title: Requirement of adequate quantity information for value comparisons
headings.reviewNote: Requiring method of sale to provide sufficiently accurate and adequate quantity information for price comparisons.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1983/1994 history note; edited subsection 1 title from 'Permissible' to 'Required' to preserve mandatory 'shall be sold' language for liquid and nonliquid commodities.

headings.title: Fee schedule for registration, inspection, and calibration services
headings.reviewNote: Establishing fee schedule for division services, device tests, and grain moisture meter location registration.

headings.title: Annual adjustment of device testing fees to cost
headings.reviewNote: Directing director of agriculture to fix annual device testing fees not to exceed total operating cost.

headings.title: Annual report to general assembly on laboratory fees and expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requiring annual October report to general assembly regarding metrology laboratory fees and operating expenses.

headings.title: Annual publication and website update of laboratory fee schedule
headings.reviewNote: Directing publication of laboratory fee schedule on departmental website within thirty days of changes.

headings.title: Rates for device retests within same calendar year
headings.reviewNote: Establishing retest rates equal to initial test rates and exempting repairs following rejection.

headings.title: Payment deadlines and condemnation or seizure for nonpayment
headings.reviewNote: Requiring fee payment within 30 days and authorizing director to condemn and seize devices for nonpayment.

headings.title: Exemption for on-farm agricultural moisture-measuring devices
headings.reviewNote: Exempting moisture-measuring devices used solely in agricultural operations on owner's land from fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all seven subsections and 1983–2023 history note; confirmed metrology/device/moisture-meter fee schedule ($500 calibration cap), annual cost adjustment, October report, website publication, retests, 30-day seizure, and on-farm exemption.

headings.title: Exemptions from weights and measures regulatory provisions
headings.reviewNote: Detailing exemptions for utility meters, petroleum fuel dispensers under chapter 414, and LPG meters under chapter 323.

headings.title: Applicability to commercial vehicle alternative fuel measuring equipment
headings.reviewNote: Specifying application of sections 413.005 to 413.229 to commercial CNG, LNG, EV charging, and hydrogen meters.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 2016 effective date; confirmed exemptions for utility, ch. 414 fuel, and ch. 323 LPG meters alongside explicit coverage of commercial CNG, LNG, EV charging, and hydrogen vehicle meters.

headings.title: Issuance and contents of notice of violation
headings.reviewNote: Governing notice of violation requirements, details of alleged violations, and warning of administrative hearings.

headings.title: Informal and formal administrative hearings, cease and desist orders, and penalties
headings.reviewNote: Establishing 14-day informal hearing opportunity, formal hearing summons, cease and desist orders, and $500 penalty.

headings.title: Deposit of assessed penalties into general revenue fund
headings.reviewNote: Directing collected civil penalties to state treasurer for credit to the general revenue fund.

headings.title: Consumer undercharges excluded from violation status
headings.reviewNote: Clarifying that consumer undercharges do not constitute violations under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1994–2002 history note; confirmed notice of violation contents, 14-day informal / formal chapter 536 hearings with $500 penalty, general revenue deposit, and consumer undercharge exclusion.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor penalty for chapter violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifying general violations of chapter 413 as class A misdemeanors.

headings.title: Class E felony penalty for purposeful or repeat violations and fraudulent devices
headings.reviewNote: Establishing class E felony classification for purposeful violations, third offenses, or altered fraudulent devices.

headings.title: Prosecutorial authority and attorney general enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Empowering county prosecutors to bring actions and authorizing attorney general enforcement upon prosecutor declination.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 2017 effective date (2014 S.B. 491); confirmed class A misdemeanor, class E felony (purposeful, third offense, or altered fraud device), and prosecutor/attorney general enforcement headings.
